# Anatomy core (vendored)

`iso-kit.ts` is copied unchanged from https://github.com/wheresryan22/anatomy (commit `1482e84`, `kit/iso-kit.ts`), MIT licence (`LICENSE`).
It is the drawing core of the house style for new topics (MASTER_PROMPT_FINAL §22). Use it through `src/lib/anatomy.tsx`
(projection equal to ours, palette from `src/theme/anatomy.ts`). Do not edit this file; to update, copy a newer commit and record it here.
The round-part (`lathe.mjs`), pipe (`tube.mjs`) and geometry-audit (`audit.mjs`) modules are planned (docs/anatomy-integration.md, П1).
